title: InGameWeb
description: InGameWeb adds a Chromium-powered in-game web browser overlay to Minecraft Fabric. Open it with Shift + Tab, browse normal websites, use multiple tabs, keep sessions persistent, and control downloads safely without leaving the game.
body:
# InGameWeb

An in-game Chromium web browser overlay for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric).

Open a full browser inside Minecraft with **Shift + Tab** — browse documentation, wikis, YouTube, and any normal website without leaving the game. Supports multiple tabs, persistent sessions, and download confirmation.


---![overlay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/436dccdcf1cb29d6814324d04ad6473b4dc2b6a9.png)


---

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition **1.21.11**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) **0.19.2+**
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) **0.141.4+1.21.11** or newer
- [MCEF \[Keksuccino's Fork\]](https://modrinth.com/mod/mcef-keksuccino) **v2.2.0+** for MC 1.21.11

MCEF is a required companion mod. It downloads Chromium binaries on first launch. An internet connection is needed for the initial setup.

---

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/).
2. Download and place **Fabric API** in your `mods/` folder.
3. Download and place **MCEF [Keksuccino's Fork]** (v2.2.0 or newer for 1.21.11) in your `mods/` folder.
4. Download and place **InGameWeb** in your `mods/` folder.
5. Launch Minecraft. MCEF will download Chromium binaries on the first run — wait for it to finish.

---

## Controls

| Action | Default | Location |
|---|---|---|
| Open overlay | **Shift + Tab** | InGameWeb Settings |
| Close overlay | **ESC** | Controls → Web - EywDev |
| Focus address bar | Ctrl + L | (in overlay) |
| New tab | Ctrl + T | (in overlay) |
| Close tab | Ctrl + W | (in overlay) |
| Back / Forward | Alt + ← / → (via browser) | (in overlay) |
| Reload | Ctrl + R (via browser) | (in overlay) |

The open shortcut supports modifier combinations such as Shift + Tab, Ctrl + M, or Alt + B. Change it from the InGameWeb settings screen using the toolbar settings button or Mod Menu. The close key is configurable in **Options → Controls → Web - EywDev**.

---

## Features

- **Full Chromium browser** powered by MCEF — real websites, YouTube, login sessions
- **Multi-tab support** — open, close, and switch tabs freely
- **URL / search bar** — type a URL or plain search query; `youtube.com` auto-prefixes `https://`
- **Google as default** homepage and search engine (configurable)
- **Persistent sessions** — cookies, cache, and login state survive Minecraft restarts
- **Download confirmation** — asks before any file is saved; you choose the destination
- **Singleplayer pause** — the game pauses while the overlay is open (configurable)
- **Config screen** — accessible from the overlay toolbar, Mod Menu, or `config/wboverlay.json`
- **Background tab handling** — tabs stay alive after closing the overlay while hidden browser views are kept lightweight
- **Optional blocklist / allowlist** — disabled by default

---

## Configuration

Open the config screen through the overlay toolbar settings button, **Mod Menu**, or edit `config/wboverlay.json` directly.

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Homepage | `https://www.google.com` | Page opened in new tabs |
| Search engine URL | Google | Must contain `%s` as the query placeholder |
| Open shortcut | `Shift + Tab` | Opens the overlay; supports Shift, Ctrl, Alt, and Super modifiers |
| Pause in singleplayer | On | Pauses the game while the overlay is open |
| Persist sessions | On | Keeps cookies and cache between sessions |
| Default download folder | `~/Downloads` | Where downloaded files are saved by default |
| Blocklist | Off | Blocks specific domains if enabled |
| Allowlist | Off | Restricts access to specific domains if enabled |

---

## Platform Support

MCEF ships Chromium binaries for:

- Windows 10/11 (x86\_64, arm64)
- macOS 11+ (Intel, Apple Silicon)
- GNU/Linux with glibc 2.31+ (x86\_64, arm64)

Other platforms are not supported by MCEF.

---

## Compatibility

| Mod | Status |
|---|---|
| Fabric API | Required |
| MCEF [Keksuccino's Fork] | Required |
| Mod Menu | Supported — config screen integration |
| Sodium | Compatible — no known conflicts |
| Iris | Compatible — no known conflicts |
| Forge / NeoForge | Not supported |

InGameWeb is **client-side only**. It does not require installation on servers and does not send any data to servers.

---

## Known Limitations

- MCEF downloads Chromium binaries (~200 MB) on first launch. This is handled by MCEF, not InGameWeb.
- Audio and video support depends on MCEF's included Chromium build and your OS. YouTube generally works on supported platforms.
- Background media can continue after closing the overlay, but performance depends on the website, video resolution, and system hardware.
- Browser initialization may fail if required system libraries are missing (see MCEF's documentation for platform requirements).
- If MCEF is not installed, InGameWeb will refuse to load (dependency check at startup).
